extensions.name: Assistant Avatar
extensions.description: 2D animated companion character that reacts to AI state and follows your cursor. Pure Canvas 2D — zero dependencies, 100% MIT. 一个会响应 AI 状态并跟随鼠标光标的 2D 动画伙伴角色；纯 Canvas 2D 实现，零依赖，MIT 许可。
extensions.author: chonsong

extensions.name: Auto List
extensions.description: Smart list typing in the message composer: pressing the newline key inside an ordered (1., 1)) or unordered (-, *, +) list item auto-inserts the next marker (preserving indent); an empty item + newline breaks out of the list; Tab indents the item by 2 spaces and Shift+Tab outdents — like modern editors. Send-key aware (acts only on the newline combo, never the send combo). Pure JS, no sidecar. 在消息输入框中智能续写列表：在有序（1.、1)）或无序（-、*、+）列表中换行会自动插入下一个标记并保留缩进；空项换行退出列表；Tab 按两空格缩进，Shift+Tab 反缩进。可感知发送键，只作用于换行组合，绝不拦截发送组合。纯 JS，无需 sidecar。
extensions.author: asorourx

extensions.name: Custom Assistant Avatar
extensions.description: Give the assistant a custom avatar image in the chat transcript. Click any assistant avatar badge to upload or clear an image; it's downscaled and stored locally and re-applied as the transcript re-renders. 在聊天记录中为助手设置自定义头像：点击助手头像徽章即可上传或清除图片，图片会压缩后保存在本地，并在消息重新渲染后自动恢复。
extensions.author: nesquena-hermes

extensions.name: Custom Branding
extensions.description: White-label the Hermes WebUI chrome with your own logo and favicon. Click the titlebar logo to upload a custom logo (swaps the titlebar + empty-state marks) and a custom favicon (swaps the browser tab icon). Images are downscaled and stored locally, and re-applied as the UI re-renders. 用自定义标志和网站图标替换 Hermes WebUI 的品牌标识：点击标题栏标志即可上传标志（同时替换标题栏和空状态图标）与网站图标；图片会压缩后保存在本地，并在界面重新渲染后自动恢复。
extensions.author: nesquena-hermes

extensions.name: Desktop Companion
extensions.description: Trusted local desktop companion for Hermes WebUI. Ships a WebUI adapter, a loopback sidecar protocol, and a native desktop pet host. 适用于 Hermes WebUI 的可信本地桌面伴侣：提供 WebUI 适配器、回环 sidecar 协议与原生桌面宠物宿主。
extensions.author: franksong2702

post_install.summary: Install enables the WebUI bridge. In the Desktop Companion repo, run npm run start:pet to launch the desktop pet.

extensions.name: E-Ink Skin
extensions.description: A maximum-contrast, near-monochrome light skin tuned for e-ink displays (Kindle, Boox, reMarkable). Pure-white background, near-black text, no gray-on-gray, flattened shadows. Registers into the native Settings → Appearance skin picker. 专为电子墨水屏优化的高对比度、近单色浅色皮肤，可在系统外观选择器中选择。
extensions.author: nesquena-hermes

extensions.name: External App Tab
extensions.description: Pin a compatible self-hosted web app as a tab inside Hermes WebUI via an iframe, or browse the profile's trusted workspaces and preview local files (HTML first) in a sandboxed frame with a top-bar workspace switcher and a collapsible file list. 将兼容的自托管 Web 应用内嵌为标签页；也可浏览可信工作区并在沙箱中预览本地文件（优先 HTML），支持顶栏工作区切换与可折叠文件列表。
extensions.author: nesquena-hermes

settings_schema.label: Last previewed file / 上次预览的文件

extensions.name: MCP Tool Shortcuts
extensions.description: Pin frequently-used MCP tools and get a one-click strip that DRAFTS a ready-to-send natural-language tool request into the composer. Never auto-executes a tool — it only inserts a prompt you review and send. Lives in Settings → MCP Tools. 固定常用的 MCP 工具，并可一键把待发送的自然语言工具请求起草到输入框；绝不自动执行工具，仅插入由你检查后发送的提示词。
extensions.author: nesquena-hermes

extensions.name: Message Pins
extensions.description: Pin individual messages in a conversation. Adds a pin button to each message, a header popover listing pinned messages with click-to-jump, and a small badge with the pin count. Pins persist locally per session. 在对话中固定个别消息：为每条消息添加固定按钮，右上角入口列出已固定消息并可点击跳转，同时显示固定数量徽标；固定记录按会话保存在本地。
extensions.author: nesquena-hermes

extensions.name: Mobile Conversations Button
extensions.description: Phone-only floating Conversations button for Hermes WebUI that opens the existing mobile conversations drawer, becomes a same-location close X while the drawer is open, and exposes long-press shortcuts. 仅在手机上显示的浮动对话按钮：打开移动端对话侧边栏，侧边栏打开后就地变为关闭图标，并支持长按快捷菜单。
extensions.author: santastabber

extensions.name: Mobile Haptics
extensions.description: A short device vibration when an assistant turn finishes, so a phone user who set the device down gets a physical "it's done" cue. Opt-in; Android / Android-PWA only (no-ops on desktop and iOS Safari). 当助手回合结束时让设备短暂振动，为放下手机的用户提供物理提示。需手动开启，仅 Android / Android-PWA 生效（桌面与 iOS Safari 无操作）。
extensions.author: nesquena-hermes

settings_schema.label: Vibrate when a turn finishes / 回合结束后振动

extensions.name: Model Favorites
extensions.description: Star your most-used models in the composer model picker. Favorited models are promoted to a ★ Favorites group at the top of the dropdown for one-click switching. Provider-aware and persisted locally. 在输入框的模型选择器中收藏常用模型，收藏项会提升到下拉列表顶部的「★ 收藏」分组，按提供商区分并保存在本地。
extensions.author: nesquena-hermes

extensions.name: Profile Avatars
extensions.description: Per-profile avatar images everywhere: profile chips, transcript assistant badges, and the session list (including other-profile chats). Server-stored via a loopback sidecar, so avatars sync across devices with zero localStorage. 每个资料的头像会显示在资料标签、聊天徽章和会话列表中，并存储在服务端，可在各设备间同步。
extensions.author: asorourx

post_install.summary: Run the bundled sidecar (sidecar/sidecar.py) on 127.0.0.1:17798, then approve the sidecar proxy in Settings → Extensions.

extensions.name: RSS Feeds
extensions.description: RSS/Atom reader for the WebUI — categorized subscriptions, keyword filters, search, read tracking, and optional AI summaries via a local loopback sidecar. 为 WebUI 提供完整的 RSS/Atom 阅读器，支持分类订阅、关键词过滤、搜索、已读跟踪，并可通过本地回环 sidecar 选用 AI 摘要。
extensions.author: asorourx

post_install.summary: Run the bundled sidecar (sidecar/sidecar.py) on 127.0.0.1:17797, then approve the sidecar proxy in Settings → Extensions.

extensions.name: Session Export to PDF
extensions.description: Export the current conversation to a clean PDF (via the browser print dialog, with a print-styled layout) or copy it as Markdown. Adds an export button to the app titlebar, or to the left rail on the redesigned banner-less homepage. No backend, no bundled PDF library. 将当前对话导出为排版干净的 PDF（通过浏览器打印对话框），或复制为 Markdown；无需后端，也不内置 PDF 库。
extensions.author: nesquena-hermes

extensions.name: Skin Pack
extensions.description: A pack of popular editor-inspired color themes (Dracula, Gruvbox, One Dark, Tokyo Night, Rosé Pine, Solarized Dark) that register into the native Settings → Appearance skin picker. 一组受主流编辑器启发的配色主题，可在系统外观选择器中选择。
extensions.author: nesquena-hermes

extensions.name: Theme Creator
extensions.description: Build your own theme: pick colors for the key design tokens, see a live preview, name it, and save. Custom themes register into the native Settings → Appearance picker. Create, edit, and delete multiple themes; everything is stored locally. 自定义主题可实时预览并保存到系统外观选择器，所有数据都保存在本地。
extensions.author: nesquena-hermes

extensions.name: Typography
extensions.description: Choose interface, conversation, and code fonts independently with curated Google Fonts, role-based presets, and browser-local imports. 可分别选择界面、对话和代码字体，支持精选 Google 字体、按角色预设以及浏览器本地导入。
extensions.author: starship-s
